quest.title: There Will Come Soft Rains
quest.description: Help Mamere collect the parts to repair Seymour.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x500, Primogem x60, Mora x50000, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

chapter.title: A Gradient of Dreams and Ochre

talks.objective: Ask about the parts in Merusea Village

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, there really is nothing here... You sure this is the place?

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: It... It should be. Father couldn't be wrong...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, Paimon didn't expect that Seymour could dive...

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Affirmative. I am equipped with the latest multi-use diving unit, with which I may always accompany my master and those composed of pure water, the...

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: Huh? Mamere? What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Where did you come from...

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: Sorry! Did I scare you? Those monsters kinda just came jumping out of those glowing circles, so I hid in the cleft of the rocks...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's all good as long as you're okay! Are you alone?

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: No, there's a friend of mine who's been trapped over there...

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: That child's name is Puca... Tall one, could I please ask you to rescue her?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave it to us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes. Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, so there was a village here too, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Yes. This place was closer to the ore veins, so...

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: As for me, I'm here because it makes it easier to care for the injured animals in the area.

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: #Anyway, we should be safe once we reach home. Thank you, {NICKNAME}, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: Thank you as well, Mamere! If it wasn't for you, we might've never made it back! Let's have tea next time we get the chance.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh come on, now's not the time to be shy!

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: I—I'm not shy! I'm just...

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: Oh, never mind, I understand.

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: #In that case, we'll go back first. Thank you for escorting us, {NICKNAME}, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: See you! Stay safe!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, guess our rescue mission's done and dusted, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Thank you for your help, and for being willing to trust me.

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Otherwise, I wouldn't have known what to do when faced with those monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: #{M#Negative. According to hypotheticals generated from previous data, milady, my sweeper mode would have been capable of negating the threat posed by those hostile lifeforms.}{F#Affirmative. If not for this lady here, I would not have been able to eliminate those lifeforms so quickly.}

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: #{M#If not for this gentleman's help, however, I would not have eliminated them as quickly. Thank you for your aid.}{F#However, hypotheticals generated from previous data indicate that my sweeper mode would have neutralized the threat posed by those hostile lifeforms, albeit requiring a longer period of time.}

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehe, {NICKNAME} and Paimon are well-seasoned adventurers, y'know! Still, what are these things doing inside Elynas?

choices.text: And they appeared alongside the quake, too.

response.speaker: Mamere
response.text: I wonder how Father is doing...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of that, Paimon thought that Father was a secret only the Melusines knew about. Paimon didn't think that the other Melusines hadn't heard of him either...

response.speaker: Mamere
response.text: That's right. No one can hear his voice, just like how no one can understand the paintings' contents.

response.speaker: Mamere
response.text: They would think that I was talking to myself whenever I spoke to Father.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's understandable...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (That means that the voice I heard then was...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, now that we've seen you repair Seymour and take us to help Puca and such, Paimon's sure that your Father must be a decent person!

response.speaker: Mamere
response.text: Absolutely! He's the best in the world...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! Everything's shaking again!

response.speaker: Mamere
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon! Those monsters... They've appeared elsewhere...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh!?

response.speaker: Mamere
response.text: This time, they've showed up where we were collecting paints previously...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You mean the place with the large house and the shipwreck?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's a long way there from here...

response.speaker: Mamere
response.text: Y—Yes, I know... Ohh, what should we do? If we don't make it in time...

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: There is no need to take the long way. We can ascend directly from here.

response.speaker: Mamere
response.text: Eh? But there should be no path up there.

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: I have just completed a full scan of the surrounding areas.

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: We need only penetrate the layers of rock above us to reach Merusea Village directly. That will allow us to reach our destination in good time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's not that simple, y'know! What do you mean "need only penetrate the layers of rock above us"... How do we do that?

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: I detect a lack of faith in my functionalities, Ms. Paimon. Concern is unnecessary. My most advanced mining module can penetrate rock layers of this thickness.

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: #{M#Noble Sir}{F#Noble and lovely Lady} {NICKNAME}, {M#please}{F#I ask you to} take me to the waters up above. I cannot maintain diving unit operation while my mining module is active.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, guess he can do that too, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No wonder you were going at them that hard...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mamere! We've collected a whole bunch of components. Will these do?

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: You've collected so many in such a short time... Amazing...

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Guess that's what I should've expected from outlanders who've experienced lots of things and met lots of people!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, we've done this sorta thing loads of times, after all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That said, how are we gonna use these components to fix Seymour?

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Don't worry, just leave it to me. Things will be alright... just like Father said!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: She opens the immobile robot dog up along the slit in its back in a manner ill-befitting of repairs.\nThen, she stuffs the scattered components on the ground into the dog seemingly without looking, as one might when well-practiced at one's job...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: With that done, she takes out a strange mechanical component from her pocket — it resembles an intricately-packaged candy with some indecipherable runes carved into it. She embeds this into the gear on the dog's head, and with a "clack," they come together...\nComponents of unknown purpose skitter across the ground. She picks them all up — they are as valuable as Mora in this place, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Will... this really work? It might just be Paimon's imagination, but it feels like more components dropped than we collected in the first place...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: On that note... The thing you pulled out a moment ago seems kinda different from those components...

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: This? Well, it's not a component. It's a token.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A token?

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: That's right. It was something we were all born with. Father said that if we put this in as well, we'd be able to cure Seymour...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait. You were born with it? Does that mean...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Actually, Paimon's not sure how Melusines are born in the first place!

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: I'm... not sure either, now that I'm considering it. But in my first memories, I had the token with me... That's how it is for everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Then isn't it something really valuable to you?

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Yes... "Tokens" are very important to us — they're different from ordinary components.

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: They were the first memento we received when we arrived in this beautiful world — they are proof that we are alive.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But if that's the case, why did you just use it like that...

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Well, I didn't throw it away or anything... Seymour will be by my side, right? And he's this way because he tried to save me, so...

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Relay module detected. Environment check... Contamination levels: High. Activating in Safe Mode.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! It suddenly moved!

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Unidentified life forms detected... Related information entered. It is a pleasure to meet you, Ms. Mamere, and...

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: #...They're {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: #You have entered this data previously. It is an honor to meet you, {M#noble Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}, and Paimon, the adorable little one.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: #{M#Thank you for your help in the previous altercation. I am Prototype 4ACV07. You may call me Seymour.}{F#It was my honor to witness your elegant swordsmanship during the previous altercation, Miss. I am Prototype 4ACV07. You may call me Seymour.}

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Up till today, for (1/7)×10^21 clockwork cycles, my functions were in hibernation, awaiting their awakening by my master, such that I may continue fulfilling my assignment.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Hibernation? Couldn't you talk normally before, though?

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: By "normal speech," you refer to my pre-configured automated responses, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: ...Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Your observation is most sharp, almost comparable to that of my master. Previously, when you would bring my artificed clockwork relay module nearby, Ms. Mamere, my main voice unit would be automatically triggered.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: An artificed clockwork relay module?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you referring to her token?

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: I apologize, but I cannot answer your question. I do not understand the meaning of this "token" you refer to.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: As such, I can make no judgment as to any relationship between this "token" and said artificed relay module.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Regardless, while hibernating, I would automatically play preset responses to specific situations to ensure that my voice-over units would work properly once energy supply was restored.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? In other words, you were just playing fixed lines before — is that what you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Affirmative. Your understanding is completely correct, Paimon, as befits your elegance and wisdom.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: A large amount of energy is required to operate my natural language processing unit. My logic unit actively shuts it off when power supply cannot be guaranteed so as to prevent complete loss of my functionality.

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: So that means...

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: So... All the things you said to me before were just... pre-written?

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Affirmative. Your understanding is correct, Ms. Mamere. During my previous hibernation, our interactions were all performed through the playback of pre-recorded voice assets.

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: *sigh* I...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Uh-oh...)

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: However, my visual and information processing modules were not shut off, so I do have the paintings you displayed in my memory unit.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: I can recognize more than one hundred and three thousand, nine hundred different styles of art, but your work does not match any of them.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: As such, I can reasonably infer that your art has unprecedented artistic value. I did not mention this before using my preset voice assets, so consider this appended to any previous related comments.

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: R—Really...?

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Affirmative.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You see? The only reason people don't understand your art is because your style is too new and unique — so don't worry about it. They'll get it in the future for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Th—Thank you, Seymour, Paimon... I was afraid that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: See, even Seymour says so. You've gotta believe in yourself, and believe in us too! We understand your paintings, and they are truly beautiful.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: In any case, thank you all for your help in restoring my lost relay module. This way, I will be able to better fulfill my mission — protect my master.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: By master, you mean Mamere? Is that why you suddenly activated to protect her when she was in danger?

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Negative. I am infinitely grateful to her for taking care of me during my hibernation. However, she is not my master. My master is...

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: I apologize. Some of my memories have suffered light damage. Inference, caused by previous damage. Unable to locate data related to "master."

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Reason for previous emergency activation is unknown. That should not have happened. I must schedule logic unit maintenance.

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Well... Why don't we have something to eat, Seymour? You've never eaten anything before. Maybe you'll figure something out once you've had your fill...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not every problem can be solved by eating, you know! Just... most of them...

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Estimated data damage: High. Attempting global search for relevant information. Searching last recorded segment.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Failure. Critical data damaged. Search procedure has been forcefully terminated.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, are you really okay? It feels like you're getting worse somehow...

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Thank you for your concern, Ms. Paimon, but do not worry. I was merely running a self-diagnostic. I can confirm that everything is operating normall—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Agh! What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (It was accompanied by a quake this time...)

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Warning. Extreme increase in environmental contamination detected.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: For your safety, please leave this place to avoid irreversible damage.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait... what kind of contamination are you talking about? What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Ah...

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon... Father says... it's dangerous, hurry...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: F—Father again? Wait... what danger? What do we have to hurry and do?

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: The scattered Melusines. Danger... There's no time to explain. Please, help me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Whatever the case, {NICKNAME}, Paimon has a real bad feeling about the quake just now. Maybe it has something to do with what Mamere was talking about. Let's get going!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, what's wrong? Why can't we continue on?

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Strange... it seems like something's blocking the way...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh, what do we do...

choices.text: We could use Seymour to break the wall down...

response.speaker: Seymour
response.text: #I apologize, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.}{NICKNAME}, but that is impossible. The thickness of the rock wall exceeds my output limits. I would run out of energy before a tunnel could be successfully bored.

response.speaker: Mamere
response.text: S—Swim... from over there... Father's... blood... is already...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Blood? Mamere, are you okay? What blood?

response.speaker: Mamere
response.text: #We cannot... delay any further. Please, {NICKNAME}... Seymour... Let's swim from over there...

response.speaker: Mamere
response.text: That's right. Swim... Over there... Because Father's blood... is already...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Blood? Mamere, are you okay? What blood?

response.speaker: Mamere
response.text: We cannot... delay any further. Let's swim from over there...

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: Thank you, tall person. Thank you, good-hearted Specter!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hang on a sec, who're you calling a Specter? Paimon's Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}... Anyway, what was all that just now? Why are you two in a place like this?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: I don't know what happened earlier either. The ground suddenly started to shake, and those scary, scary monsters started to show up... *sob*

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: Puca and I were here to pick up those beautiful stones. We've been here many times, and this never happened, nor have we ever seen those frightening creatures...

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: So... I've been wanting to ask this, but why is Mamere here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Mamere brought us here.

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: Huh? But how did you know we were here?

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: #...Father told me. He told me that you were in danger, and that I should ask {NICKNAME} and Paimon to come and save you...

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Father...?

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: Ah, I see, so it was Father who asked you to come and save us... Thank you, Mamere!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Eh? So you know who Father is, Glaisti?)

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: (Um, no?)

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: (Still, Mamere always talks to herself about how she is able to speak to "Father." I've always supposed that that's her imaginary friend — she's largely alone otherwise...)

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: I don't know what's going on, but thank you all the same...

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Don't thank me, I didn't do anything... Father's the one who told me what to do...

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: My apologies for interrupting, Ms. Mamere, Ms. Puca. Considering our surroundings, I suggest that we leave this place post-haste to avoid further attacks.

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Agh! Another dog appeared...!

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: Calm down, Puca! This is the robotic dog Mamere picked up before, right?

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: Hmm... It couldn't move before, though, could it?

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: A keen observation, Ms. Glaisti.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Regardless, my logic circuits recommend that we not tarry. Please allow me to escort you to a safe location. The contamination index here has exceeded the threshold of human tolerance.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Contamination index?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Could that be related to the hallucinations I saw earlier...?)

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: A... safe place? So do we just need to go back home?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup! Paimon doesn't know what Seymour means by this "contamination index" stuff, but we might get attacked again if we stay here, so let's get you all home safe first!

dialogues.speaker: Glaisti
dialogues.text: Got it. Thank you, Ms. Paimon! You've got a good heart!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, alright, let's go!

talks.objective: Head to the designated location through the shortcut
Use the Prismatic Resonance to investigate the ore

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The prismatic resonance shatters the ore, and a Melusine unexpectedly falls out...\nYou rush over to help her up, and fortunately, she doesn't appear to be injured...

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Huh? Mamere? What are you doing here? And you are...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon's Paimon, and {M#he}{F#she}'s {NICKNAME}. Mamere brought us here.

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Ah, is that so? Thank you all! My name is Virda, but just call me Vi. I'm an apprentice agent of the Marechaussee Phantom!

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Still, um, I didn't think I would get into this mess. How embarrassing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: An apprentice agent? Ooh, so you're with the authorities in Fontaine!

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Uh, no, no, it's a self-proclaimed title at the moment. One day, though, I'll be a proper agent, just like Sedile!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, so you can give yourself that title?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, what happened just now? Why did you end up hiding inside a rock?

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Eh? Did I do something like that? I don't remember.

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: I just remember falling down while fleeing, but nothing else after that...

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: That... was Father protecting you.

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Father?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Ah, never mind that for now — even {NICKNAME} and Paimon don't know what that's about...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: More importantly, are there any other Melusines trapped here?

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Hmm, I didn't see anyone else. I was doing special training alone here, after all...

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: But I did catch sight of some humans I've never seen before... Might've been four of them?

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Humans you've never seen before? What?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait just a sec. Did you come across some purple guy and three people in red scarves?

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: That's right! Are they your friends?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, how should we explain this...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Virda about what happened before...

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Huh!? So that actually happened?

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Now that I think about it, they *were* behaving very suspiciously! *sigh* I guess I still have a lot to learn. Were Sedile in my shoes...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you see which way they went?

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Yes! They were heading that way!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Alright then. Let's go after them, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Kaykaus
dialogues.text: S—Sis! Why are these things still chasing us!?

dialogues.speaker: Irus
dialogues.text: Do I look like I know, you numbskull? It's just bad luck— Agh, c'mon, are they seriously still coming!?

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Ah! It's those suspicious people! Stop! Don't run!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Be careful! Those things behind them are...

dialogues.speaker: Irus
dialogues.text: Ugh, you're—! P—Please help! We'll pay you, I swear!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Uh oh, all those monsters are coming this way! Careful, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Excess hostile reactions detected. Switching to purification mode. For your own safety, Ms. Mamere, please keep a certain distance.

dialogues.speaker: Irus
dialogues.text: Saved at last... Whoa, hey, hey, what are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Arresting the masterminds behind the summoning of these creatures — what else?

dialogues.speaker: Kaykaus
dialogues.text: W—Wait, we didn't do anything! We were just being chased by those monsters, honest!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's going on? Tell us everything! Also, what about that purple guy... Where's Jakob?

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: That's right, confess!

dialogues.speaker: Irus
dialogues.text: *sigh* Whatever. Now that it's come to this, we might as well come clean. Just our luck, seriously... We should never have taken this job...

dialogues.speaker: Irus
dialogues.text: That madman got us to bring him those red stones... Y'know, those you gathered previously. He said they'd be important.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Important for what?

dialogues.speaker: Irus
dialogues.text: For whatever the heck he was going to do with them! He didn't tell us anything else. Just "get me the ores" — by Al-Ahmar, we're mercs, not miners!

dialogues.speaker: Irus
dialogues.text: And we did it for him, alright — for half a day we worked! And at the end of it, he didn't even pay us when we gave him his damned ores. He even started saying some... weird stuff!

dialogues.speaker: Irus
dialogues.text: We hadn't even caught what he said before he took the fragments and left, dropping us like a sack of potatoes with a "useless," and a "I guess old ways are the best" — and no pay either!

dialogues.speaker: Irus
dialogues.text: I was going to get even with that scoundrel, but he did some hand-sign and blabbered out... something in a language I didn't know. That's when those monsters appeared, and they chased us all the way here. Why, that scumbag...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did he summon the monsters at the other locations?

dialogues.speaker: Irus
dialogues.text: What? What other locations are you talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: The same monsters appeared in areas around the village, and they're attacking Melusines wherever they find them!

dialogues.speaker: Irus
dialogues.text: Wait... Did something like that happen? I didn't know, I swear! After leaving your place, that Jakob guy led us to the intersection up ahead. We didn't really delay...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So basically, he never told you anything except that you should go steal the paintings?

dialogues.speaker: Irus
dialogues.text: Ugh, don't even bring it up... Never mind "telling" us anything — that charlatan didn't even "pay" us our deposit!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why'd you work so hard for someone who doesn't even pay a deposit!?

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Is it because... you thought he was handsome?

dialogues.speaker: Kaykaus
dialogues.text: Oh, so you like purple, do you, Boss?

dialogues.speaker: Irus
dialogues.text: What in the world are you talking about, you idiot? Of course not! How's that guy handsome, anyway — also, what kind of reason is "I like purple"!?

dialogues.speaker: Irus
dialogues.text: Hmph! Well, he sure looked like he was in the Mora! I hoped that a little extra enthusiasm might get him to part with more of it, so I decided to waive his deposit...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And that's what you call a self-inflicted wound...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh. Looks like we won't be able to get anything useful from these guys. How should we deal with them now...

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Hehe, don't worry, leave it to me. I'm not an official agent yet, but I can escort them back to the village and hand them over to Sedile, no problem!

dialogues.speaker: Irus
dialogues.text: W—W—Wait just a moment! Aren't we victims too?

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: You...! You ransacked my house, hurt Seymour... and still, you claim to be victims...

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Hmph, that's right, that's— wait, whose house did they ransack?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Stop! That's not the main point!

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Exactly! To think that you'd even do something like that! Hmph, you're incorrigible! Come with me, now, and don't you dare resist!

dialogues.speaker: Irus
dialogues.text: W—Wait! You're going after that guy, aren't you? We know where he's gone!

dialogues.speaker: Irus
dialogues.text: Listen, he's headed towards the place where the giant rock is hanging. Y'know, over that way... If you give chase now, you could still catch him!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The place with a giant stone? Wait, you mean...

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: It's a warm place that makes people at ease...

choices.text: Why would you tell us this?

response.speaker: Irus
response.text: Hey, even mercenaries know how to be picky about our employers! That self-serving, monster-summoning fraudster is no employer of mine, no matter how much he's offering!

response.speaker: Irus
response.text: Not that he even paid us the deposit in the first place, I mean!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aaaaah! Everything's shaking again!

response.speaker: Kaykubad
response.text: Hey, Sis, do you think this earthquake could be...

response.speaker: Irus
response.text: Crap. If more of those monsters show up... H—Hey, shorty, you wanted to arrest us, right? Quick, do it now! We surrender — unconditionally!

response.speaker: Virda
response.text: Huh, that's more like it! Go reform yourselves at the Fortress of Meropide and learn to be useful to society!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... Guess we'll leave them to you. We'll get to the bottom of these quakes.

response.speaker: Virda
response.text: Hmph. Alright, mercs, don't get any funny ideas, or the Maison Gardiennage are gonna show you what for!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After disarming the mercenaries and tying their hands, Virda escorts them away.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #So, uh, what are we supposed to do now, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Mamere
response.text: ...Ugh!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mamere? What's wrong? You don't look good at all...

response.speaker: Mamere
response.text: No, it's not that... it's... Father...

response.speaker: Mamere
response.text: It hurts... No... Why are you doing that...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...I heard it too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #And you look just as horrible, {NICKNAME}! You heard something? What did you hear?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm fine, but...

response.speaker: Mamere
response.text: That's right... There's no time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even if you say that... Shouldn't you rest for a bit? You look like you're hurting all over...

response.speaker: Mamere
response.text: Yes... It hurts... I've never... experienced anything like this before.

response.speaker: Mamere
response.text: But I must go... Father must be suffering far more than I am...

response.speaker: Mamere
response.text: #Please... {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Please... take me there. To the place where we gathered high-purity ores earlier...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay. Let's go! There should be a shortcut we can take!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So we've gotta hurry... to the place where we collected the paints previously?

response.speaker: Mamere
response.text: #Yes... Please, {NICKNAME}, Paimon... We have to get over there...

choices.text: Even so, we won't let you off so easy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a second! Why would these things be here!?

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Hostile reactions detected. Threat assessment: intermediate. Seymour, entering sweeper mode. Please get behind me, Ms. Mamere.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Mining module activated.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? You just smashed that to pieces...

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: #You're... pretty strong, aren't you, Seymour? Actually, now's not the time to worry about that. C'mon, {NICKNAME}, Paimon, we need to get back quickly!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She's trapped there... Let's find some way to get rid of this seagrass!

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Um... P—Please, get away from me! I—I'm just a normal Melusine, and I'm not tasty at all! Even if you did eat me, it wouldn't fill your tummy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, silly! We're here to save you! We got rid of the monsters already. You're Puca, right?

dialogues.speaker: Puca
dialogues.text: Um... Y—Yes?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. Who'd have thought that a Melusine could get caught in seagrass...
